firstPlayerRule: Take all the pawns and blindly draw one. That pawn’s player goes first.
clarifications: This is the last setup step (“Begin play”), done at the start of each game in the campaign.
Play proceeds clockwise: after a player finishes infecting cities, the player on their left goes next.
